name: battery_mgmt
display: Battery management ICs (chargers, protection, gauges, balancers)
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-07 as Marcus starts charge/discharge/balance board design. EXPECTATION-SETTING (verified by raw-attrs probe): this is the WORST-documented bucket in the catalogue — ~57% of even top-stock parts (the TP4056-clone world) carry no parametric attributes at all, so ~20% coverage on typed columns is the genuine ceiling, not an alias bug. The recipe still shortlists honestly; the architecture choice (integrated charger vs AFE+MCU, protection topology) lives in datasheets.
columns: __comment_chip_type__: 'Battery Protection Chip' / charger / gauge etc — the
routing column for this mixed bucket. Filter --where "chip_type ~ protect"

columns.name: chip_type
attrs: Type of the Power Management Chip

columns: determines charge voltage; filter --where "battery_type ~ LiFePO4" when
building for that chemistry, and don't assume silence means Li-ion.
Key exists on ~9% of parts with a real value — sparse but load-bearing.
__comment_balance__: only a handful of parts carry 'Balance Current' — but for
a balancing-BMS search a non-NULL here is a strong signal the part is an
AFE/balancer, so the sparse column earns its keep.
__comment_interface__: 'I2C'/'SMBus' — presence usually means fuel gauge or
smart AFE rather than a dumb protector.
